title: Ogg Vorbis radio stations play (manual until automated)

clauses.text: A live Ogg Vorbis station plays through the helper iyakki-audiodec at the right speed and pitch.

steps.do: Open Radio and play a live station whose stream is Ogg Vorbis.
steps.expect: The station plays clearly through the speakers for several minutes, at normal pitch and speed.

clauses.text: A stereo station plays both channels.

steps.do: Play a stereo Ogg Vorbis station and listen left and right.
steps.expect: Both sides carry sound. Neither is silent or swapped.

clauses.text: A stream that cannot be played, such as FLAC or MP4, is refused in words.

steps.do: Try a FLAC or MP4 station, if you have one.
steps.expect: The radio says in words that it cannot play that kind of stream. It does not stay silent.
